description: Enflite backend-ai API (backend/). Claude-only launch: OLLAMA_ENABLED stays false, so the app needs no Ollama host. Deploy with: git subtree push --prefix backend heroku main. See docs/heroku.md.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key. This is the serving model for the Claude-only launch.

COOKIE_SECURE.description: Mandatory in production; cookies are only sent over HTTPS.

CORS_ORIGIN.description: Exact https URL of the frontend app, e.g. https://enflite-ai-web-abc123.herokuapp.com. No wildcards; config validation rejects them.

EMBEDDING_API_KEY.description: API key for the OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint.

EMBEDDING_BASE_URL.description: Only for EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=openai-compatible, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1. Its origin must also be added to AI_PROVIDER_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.

EMBEDDING_MODEL.description: Only for EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=openai-compatible. Must be 1536-dimensional (production boot guard), e.g. text-embedding-3-small.

EMBEDDING_PROVIDER.description: Optional: set to 'openai-compatible' with EMBEDDING_* vars below to enable document ingestion/RAG on Heroku. With the default 'ollama' and OLLAMA_ENABLED=false, chat works but document embedding fails with a clear error.

JWT_SECRET.description: High-entropy secret (>= 32 chars). Documented placeholders are refused at boot in production.

MALWARE_SCANNER_ENDPOINT.description: HTTP malware scanner URL reachable from Heroku, e.g. https://scanner.example.com/scan. Required in production; document uploads cannot run without it.

MALWARE_SCAN_MODE.description: Production boot requires 'http'. There is no scan bypass in production.

MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB Atlas connection string, e.g. mongodb+srv://user:pass@cluster.mongodb.net/enflite-ai. Atlas IP allowlist must include Heroku (0.0.0.0/0 or PrivateLink).

NODE_ENV.description: Enables production boot guards (strict secret, cookie, scanner checks).

OBJECT_STORAGE_BUCKET.description: Private bucket for document and attachment bytes.

OBJECT_STORAGE_ENDPOINT.description: S3-compatible endpoint for document/attachment storage, e.g. https://s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com. The backend has no local-disk storage backend.

OBJECT_STORAGE_FORCE_PATH_STYLE.description: true for MinIO-style endpoints, false for AWS S3.

OLLAMA_ENABLED.description: Keep false for the Claude-only launch. No Ollama host is needed while off.

name: Enflite AI API
